other_conditions: Applicant must have adequate space or shed for keeping the animals
Applicant should not already have more than 2 cows of indigenous advanced breeds such as Gir, Sahiwal, Haryana, Tharparkar or F‑1 hybrid breeds
Applicant must purchase indigenous improved‑breed cows from outside Uttar Pradesh
Cows purchased must be of first or second calving
Cows must be disease‑free and healthy
Applicant must take animal insurance for all purchased cows for 3 years
Applicant must take transit insurance for transporting the cows from the place of purchase to the establishment site
benefits_summary: Grants covering up to 40% of the total unit cost (maximum ₹80,000) are released directly into the beneficiary's bank account via DBT.
